title: DominusObject
description: Canonical schema for a .dominus Meta-Bin object. Every asset the engine manages is an instance of this schema.

dominus_version.description: Semver of the schema this object was authored against. DominusSerializer must refuse to load an object whose major version is newer than the running engine's.

object_id.description: Stable, lowercase, snake_case identifier. Never renamed once shipped -- rename via a new evolution_history entry, not by mutating this field.

entity_type.description: Free-form tag ("organism", "character", "npc", "economy", "city", ...). The engine does not own or validate this vocabulary -- no behavior is implied by the tag alone, it is metadata a future extension can filter on.

provenance.description: The entity's birth certificate: who/what created it, from what assets, under what method, descended from which parent entities.

creation_hash.description: Free-form -- typically a SHA-256 digest from the Registry Prototype's GenomeCompiler when this entity's genome was compiled through that pipeline, but this field has zero dependency on that system.

social_genome.description: Points at a SocialGenome file (personality traits + relationships). Dominus Engine reads this and interprets nothing -- what a relationship DOES is a future extension's job.

creature_genome.description: Points at a CreatureGenome file (12 sections: Identity, Taxonomy, Anatomy, Physiology, Senses, Locomotion, Cognition, Behavior, Ecology, CombatProfile, Growth, Evolution). Strictly validated on load -- species_name is required, all [0,1]-range fields are checked. Pure data; no evolution simulation, no ecosystem generation, no decoder yet.

combat_style_genome.description: Points at a CombatStyleGenome file -- a real, structured referent for CombatIdentity.style (which stays a plain free-form string, LAW C002/C003 untouched). Styles are their own entities, decoupled from any one fighter; this ref is how one entity declares which style file it currently uses.

combat_physics_genome.description: Points at a CombatPhysicsGenome file (body/energy/impact -- mass, armor, stamina, strike force, durability). Consumed standalone by COMBAT::ImpactSolver; not yet wired into ReactionSystem/CombatController's live hit resolution.

game_design_genome.description: Points at a GameDesignGenome file (genre/core_loop/difficulty/risk_reward_balance). Read by GameDesignCoherenceChecker against a CombatStyleGenome/CombatPhysicsGenome to produce advisory (never pass/fail) coherence notes.

material_genome.description: Points at a MaterialGenome file (a material/object's type, age, wear, exposure -- state, not rendering). wear_state can be author-set or derived from real WORLD::WorldHistory damage_event entries via MaterialWearDeriver.

visual_style_genome.description: Points at a VisualStyleGenome file (an art style as comparable, referenceable data -- line/color/shape/motion behavior, plus influences). Data only, no auto-combine/fusion algorithm.

combat_dna.description: Points at combat-genome-director output. Dominus Engine reads this, it does not generate it.

evolution_history.description: Append-only. Never rewritten. Every save that changes the object appends an entry here.
